hypotheses.title: Intraday Open-to-Close Return Mean-Reversion (pv1 - 100% Coverage)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Isolates pure daytime active trading from open to close, stripping out overnight macro gap risk. Persistent multi-day daytime buying exhausts retail liquidity, compensating market makers who absorb inventory for next-day mean-reversion. 100% instrument coverage across TOP3000 and 0 portfolio collision.
confounders: Major midday news announcements triggering runaway multi-day momentum
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during aggressive bull trend regimes where daytime momentum continues uninterrupted for weeks.

hypotheses.title: Accumulation/Distribution Oscillator Mean-Reversion (pv1 - 100% Coverage)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Classic Chaikin Money Flow multiplier: computes where close finished relative to the daily high-low midpoint ((2*close - high - low) / (high - low)). Strictly bounded in [-1, 1]. Equities pinned near daily extremes for 5 consecutive days face sharp inventory rebalancing reversion. 100% coverage eliminates weight concentration risk.
confounders: Zero-range trading days on halted stocks
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms when extreme closes reflect durable fundamental multiple reratings.

candidates.expression: group_rank(-ts_decay_linear((2 * close - high - low) / (high - low + (0.001 * close)), 5), subindustry)

hypotheses.title: Candlestick Shadow Asymmetry Rejection Reversal (pv1 - 100% Coverage)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Measures net structural rejection: upper shadow (selling pressure at highs) minus lower shadow (buying support at lows), divided by total daily range. When upper shadow dominates persistently over 5 days, buyers are repeatedly rejected by institutional overhead supply. Zero portfolio overlap.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during low-liquidity holiday regimes where shadow wicks reflect random noise.

candidates.expression: group_rank(-ts_decay_linear(((high - max(open, close)) - (min(open, close) - low)) / (high - low + (0.001 * close)), 5), subindustry)
